$comment: Ghost teams + scripted season arc for The Amazing Race: Home Edition — the rematch season, five legs around the house. Placements are SCRIPTED and never computed. Tokens usable in any line: {team} = player's team name, {points} = points earned this leg, {done} = challenges completed, {total} = challenges available.

teams.name: Team Maple
teams.tagline: Back, and still one step ahead.
teams.personality: Your oldest rivals, back for revenge. Friendly, fast, and they have been training all year.

teams.name: The Rock Hoppers
teams.tagline: This time WE win the photo finish.
teams.personality: Cheerful daredevils from Newfoundland. You beat them by one step last summer. They remember.

teams.name: Prairie Thunder
teams.personality: Ranch kids who run first and read the map later. A whole year of practice — at running, not at maps.

teams.name: The Tide Riders
teams.personality: Laid-back surfers from Nova Scotia. They found your couch extremely comfortable. Too comfortable.

maple.farewell: Ava: "Two seasons, and you finally got us twice. Go win it, {team}!"
maple.onOtherElimination: Liam: "Safe travels, friends. That was a great race."
maple.finale: Ava: "We always knew {team} was the team to beat."

rockhoppers.farewell: Finn: "We climbed every stair in this house. Worth it!"
rockhoppers.onOtherElimination: Rose: "Big hugs. You made us race harder."
rockhoppers.finale: Finn: "Two photo finishes, two wins for {team}. Unbelievable!"

prairie.farewell: Wyatt: "We were fast. We were just fast in the wrong room!"
prairie.onOtherElimination: June: "Aw, no. Ride safe, you two."
prairie.finale: June: "We were cheering for {team} from the very first mat."

tide.farewell: Coco: "That couch was a trap. A comfy, comfy trap."
tide.onOtherElimination: Marlow: "That is rough. Catch you back home."
tide.finale: Marlow: "Told you. {team} had the good vibes."

legs.title: Meet the Teams — The Rematch
ceremonyLines: Welcome back, {team} — the defending CHAMPIONS!
Four old rivals have come to your house for a rematch.
Five legs. One trophy. And this time... they know your tricks.

intros.tease: Team Maple led your whole first season. They want that feeling back.
The Rock Hoppers lost the finale by ONE step. They have not forgotten.
Prairie Thunder spent a year practising. Running, that is. Not directions.
The Tide Riders just found your couch. This could be trouble for them.

outroLines: Five legs, one house, one House Cup.
legs.nextLegTease: Leg 1: mystery bites and spoon counting in the kitchen.

legs.title: Kitchen Confidential
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number TWO!
First leg of the rematch and you are right at the front.
This is a non-elimination leg — everyone races on!
But look behind you. Nobody is slowing down this season.
legs.closeCall: Team Maple reached the kitchen table forty seconds ahead. Some things never change!

statsLines.heavy: You banked {points} points and finished every kitchen challenge — a champion's start! But Team Maple set the table forty seconds faster.
statsLines.mid: {done} of {total} challenges done and {points} points banked for your season score. Team Maple was just forty seconds quicker to the mat.
statsLines.light: You banked {points} points for your season score. Team Maple found the spoons faster today — forty seconds faster!

legs.nextLegTease: Next: out the back door for the Backyard Expedition.

legs.title: Backyard Expedition
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number four.
A tough leg. Even champions have hard days.
One team may be eliminated tonight.
Shake it off. The second floor is waiting for you.
legs.closeCall: The Tide Riders drifted onto the mat one minute ahead of you. One minute!

statsLines.heavy: You worked so hard out there — {done} challenges and {points} points, all going to your season score. But three teams found the backyard mat just a little faster.
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score today. The Tide Riders simply crossed the yard one minute faster.
statsLines.light: You banked {points} points for your season score. The yard was big today, and the other teams found the faster lines through it.

eliminationLines: Prairie Thunder... you were the fastest team out of the kitchen.
You were also the only team to get lost between two rooms of one house.
I'm sorry to tell you... you've been eliminated from the race.
legs.nextLegTease: Next: secrets, socks and a detour on the second floor.

legs.title: Secrets of the Second Floor
ceremonyLines: {team}... you are team number ONE!
From fourth place to first in one leg. THAT is a champion's comeback.
But one team may be eliminated tonight.
legs.closeCall: Team Maple hit the mat thirty seconds behind you. The Sock Ninja made the difference!

statsLines.heavy: {points} points and {done} challenges — all going to your season score. And your time on the course was the fastest in the whole house, by thirty seconds!
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score, plus a first-place finish. Your sock-matching time left Team Maple thirty seconds behind.
statsLines.light: {points} points added to your season score today. Your time on the course was still the best — thirty seconds ahead!

eliminationLines: Tide Riders... we found you asleep in a blanket fort at the top of the stairs.
It was, honestly, a very good blanket fort.
I'm sorry to tell you... you've been eliminated from the race.
legs.nextLegTease: Next: engines on for the Couch 500 in the living room.

legs.title: The Couch 500
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number two.
The Rock Hoppers just won their first leg of the season.
And one team may be eliminated tonight...
After this mat, only TWO teams race for the House Cup.
legs.closeCall: The Rock Hoppers caught the last bagel twenty seconds before you reached the mat.

statsLines.heavy: {done} challenges and {points} points — all banked for your season score. The Rock Hoppers' time on the couch course was just twenty seconds quicker.
statsLines.mid: {points} points added to your season score in the arcade leg. The Rock Hoppers edged the course by twenty seconds — they want that rematch.
statsLines.light: {points} points banked for your season score. The Rock Hoppers found the faster time today, and they are hungry for the finale.

eliminationLines: Team Maple... two seasons. Nine mats in first or second place.
Tonight, for the very first time, you were last.
I'm sorry to tell you... you've been eliminated from the race.
legs.nextLegTease: The finale is set: {team} versus The Rock Hoppers. Again. Winner takes the House Cup.

legs.title: THE FINALE: Race for the House Cup
photoFinishLines: Two teams. One driveway. Here they come!
The Rock Hoppers are right beside you... AGAIN...
ceremonyLines: {team}... you are the WINNERS of The Amazing Race: Home Edition!
Five legs, one house, and TWO photo finishes against the same team.
Back-to-back champions. The House Cup is yours!
legs.closeCall: Another photo finish! You crossed the driveway one step ahead of The Rock Hoppers. Again!

statsLines.heavy: {points} points and {done} challenges on the final leg — all in your season score. And your time on the course? Fastest one last time — a photo finish!
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score on the last leg. Your time on the course was exactly enough to win the photo finish.
statsLines.light: {points} points added to your season score, one perfect finish. Champions do not need to be fancy — just first to the driveway.

recapLines: Let's look back at your whole race, {team}.
Every room, every badge, every photo.
Back-to-back champions of The Amazing Race!
legs.nextLegTease: Take the House Cup — and maybe a snack. You earned both.
